articles.summary: Wholesale price inflation accelerated to 12.29 per cent in October from 11.39 per cent in September, driven largely by a sharp rise in fuel and power prices, according to data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Monday.

articles.title: Karnataka to make meters mandatory in all taxis, ban half helmets
articles.summary: Addressing a press conference, Karnataka Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh said the government was taking steps to protect the interests of taxi owners and drivers, who had submitted him a memorandum in this regard.

articles.title: India's youth do not lack enterprise–they lack the right ecosystem: Lakshmi Venkataraman
articles.summary: Lakshmi Venkataraman Venkatesan, Founder of BYST, calls for larger loans, institutionalised mentorship, regulatory reforms and AI adoption to transform India's Grampreneurs into engines of growth and jobs.

articles.title: Rajasthan earmarks ₹3,200 crore for tribal development over three years
articles.summary: Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma says funds will support education, healthcare, infrastructure and economic empowerment; development initiatives cover 6,235 villages and 55 lakh tribal people.

articles.title: India, Egypt discuss steps to boost trade, address non-tariff barriers
articles.summary: Cairo and India have engaged in discussions to boost bilateral trade to USD 12 billion. A Joint Working Group will be established to explore trade agreements and facilitate market access.

articles.title: Rajasthan announces ₹9,321 crore relief package for drought-hit areas
articles.summary: Package covers 87 tehsils across 15 districts; state government directs departments to ensure drinking water, fodder, irrigation and livelihood support.

articles.title: India's trade deficit likely to ease in November as oil, gold imports cool: Emkay
articles.summary: Despite the widening merchandise trade gap, Emkay sees scope for a lower current account deficit amid softer crude prices and stronger capital inflows.

articles.title: India's unemployment rate eases to 4.9% in October; female participation rises
articles.summary: Overall urban unemployment declined to 6.7 per cent from 6.9 per cent in September, while rural unemployment remained unchanged at 4.2 per cent.

articles.title: Drone industry targets ₹97300 crore by 2031 as DFI pushes for indigenous components
articles.summary: Drone Federation India has proposed 22 policy reforms to strengthen indigenous component manufacturing, reduce import dependence and support India's projected ₹97,300 crore drone industry by 2031.

articles.title: India eyes bigger trade, investment ties with Egypt, says Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: Goyal emphasised the importance of two-way trade and investment opportunities for both nations. India has focused on expanding its global trade agreements, aiming for increased market access.
